BL-1706 — Swarm stamp-off: hotfix 7d109d3b2e - consult-eligible? refuses the mono-router consult spawn outright on a pack that declares `config single_inference_slot 1`, so a stuck role's session never contends with the mid-turn resident for a one-request-at-a-time local model; every other pack unchanged - review-only certification (BL-848) of what landed on 2026-09-23
What it solves: ## What
An operator hotfix is live on main and has never been through a gate.
This is that gate: a REVIEW ticket - confirm or refute, and open narrow
follow-ups for anything found.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed. What needs sign-off is the DISPOSITION only - that reviewing the landed diff of 7d109d3b2e (BL-848 posture) rather than re-implementing it is right, and that medium is the right severity for a review of behaviour already li…
BL-1706 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1706" (or "reject BL-1706 <reason>") to act.
